description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'EventBusService' that provides request handling and lifecycle management for services using Vert.x's event bus. It includes mechanisms for tracing with OpenTracing, message processing, and lifecycle hooks for startup and shutdown.

classes.name: EventBusService
classes.description: An abstract base service class that handles registration on Vert.x event bus, request processing, and tracing support for Eclipse Hono API services.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing tracer implementation; defaults to a no-op tracer if not provided.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service by registering the event bus consumer and invoking subclass startup routines.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to implement any startup logic beyond registration.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the event bus address this service listens on.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service by unregistering the consumer and calling subclass shutdown routines.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Hook for subclasses for additional shutdown logic.

methods.name: registerConsumer
methods.description: Registers a Vert.x event bus consumer for incoming messages.

methods.name: processRequestMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, extracts tracing context, invokes processRequest, and sends replies.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to process a service request message asynchronously.

methods.name: getTypesafeValueForField
methods.description: Utility to safely extract a value of a specific type from a JSON object.

methods.name: removeTypesafeValueForField
methods.description: Utility to remove and return a value of a specified type from a JSON object.

methods.name: getRequestPayload
methods.description: Retrieves or augments the payload from a request message, ensuring 'enabled' property is set.

methods.name: finishSpanOnFutureCompletion
methods.description: Completes a tracing span upon the completion or failure of a future.

calls: Processing methods invoked in processRequest (to be implemented by subclasses)
